# NegoTrack

> NegoTrack is a business-health and digital-growth monitoring platform for small
> businesses in the United Kingdom and Spain. It brings website health, search
> visibility, page speed, mobile usability, reviews, local presence and competitor
> signals into one plain-language view, and turns them into an ordered list of
> what to fix first.
>
> NegoTrack is NOT negotiation software, sales software or a contract-management
> tool. The name comes from the Spanish word "negocio" (business) combined with
> "track" (to monitor over time). An unrelated product with a similar name exists;
> this is not it.
>
> Status: pre-launch. The waiting list is open; the private beta has not started.
> No live scanning service is operating. Every product figure shown on the site is
> clearly labelled demonstration data, not real customer or usage data.
